command:
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('CHANGELOG.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
head, _, _rest = text.partition('## [1.4.1]')
assert '## [Unreleased]' in head
assert 'init --preset django' in head
assert 'migrations' in head.lower()
print('ok')
